title: 1983 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Pig
seo_title: 1983 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Pig (13 February – 1 February 1984)
description: 1983 is the Year of the Water Pig (Yin, Gui-hai), from 13 February 1983 to 1 February 1984. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1983.
lead: Born in 1983? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Pig, but check the date: the 1983 Water Pig year began on 13 February 1983. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1983: Year of the Water Pig, from 13 February 1983 to 1 February 1984.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1983 was the Year of the Pig. It began with Lunar New Year on 13 February 1983 and ended on 1 February 1984, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1983 ends in 3, which makes it a Water year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1983 is a Gui-hai year. The same Water Pig combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1923 before it and 2043 after it.
Lunar New Year 1983 fell on 13 February 1983, so everyone born in January 1983, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Dog.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Pig guide describes the sign like this: “Warm-hearted, generous, and easygoing. Pigs value comfort, kindness, and honest relationships.” The usual watch-out: “Can be overly trusting or indulgent.”

The Water element adds its own flavour. Water years bring intuition, adaptability, and calm wisdom. People of this element tend to be thoughtful, diplomatic, and perceptive. Read more in our Water element guide, or the full Year of the Pig page.
Careers often linked with the Pig: hospitality, food industry, teaching, healthcare.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1983
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Pig's best matches are the Tiger, Rabbit and Goat, and its clash sign is the Snake, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Pig, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Pig, it shares the Goat's triangle (Rabbit, Goat and Pig), so 2027 is traditionally favourable. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Pig years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1959 (Earth Pig); 1971 (Metal Pig); 1995 (Wood Pig); 2007 (Fire Pig). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1983 is the Year of the Pig, a Yin Water Pig year (Gui-hai).
When does the 1983 Year of the Pig start and end?
It starts on 13 February 1983 and ends on 1 February 1984.
I was born in January 1983. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Dog: Lunar New Year 1983 was on 13 February 1983, so all of January 1983 belongs to the Dog year.
Water. 1983 ends in 3, which belongs to Water, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Pig compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Rabbit and Goat. The Pig's clash sign is the Snake.
